newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade light at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade light at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry and demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date, 74,700 head confirmed including
13,000 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175 lbs 72.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 72.00.
